message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The case: two defendants beat victim, victim died from acute coronary attack due to fight, also had nasal bone fractures (light injury). The prosecution says they committed intentional injury causing death. In Chinese criminal law, causing death by intentional injury is "故意伤害致死" which is a specific offense under Article 234 (intentional injury causing death) or Article 232? Actually Article 234: "故意伤害罪" includes causing death, with penalty up to 7 years or more. There's also "故意杀人罪" but here intent was to injure not kill. So charge: "故意伤害致死". In examples, they label as "故意伤害". For similar case earlier: they had "故意伤害;虐待". So they used "故意伤害". So answer likely "故意伤害". Possibly also "故意伤害致人死亡" but they just use "故意伤害". So final answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>
